relations.subject: Artemus B. Engle
relations.evidence: IN THE SPRING of 1972... it was my immense good fortune to meet a truly extraordinary Tibetan Buddhist teacher... My teacher, known then as Geshe Lobsang Tharchin... I was his first Dharma student in the United States

relations.subject: Geshe Lobsang Tharchin
relations.evidence: Geshe Lobsang Tharchin, had studied at the Mey College of Sera Monastery near Lhasa, Tibet and earned the Lharampa Geshe title with honors in 1953.

relations.subject: Geshe Lobsang Tharchin
relations.evidence: He also completed Tantric studies at Gyumed College before escaping to India in 1959.
